def transition
  (s : Snapshot) (req : Request) :
  Result (core.result.Result Reply Error)
  := do
  match req.op with
  | Op.Messages room «from» «to» dir limit filter =>
    api_message.get_message_events_route s req.user room «from» «to» dir
      limit filter
  | Op.Context room event limit filter =>
    api_context.get_context_route s req.user room event limit filter
  | Op.Relations room event rel_type event_type «from» «to» limit recurse
    dir =>
    api_relations.paginate_relations_with_filter s req.user room event
      event_type rel_type «from» «to» limit recurse dir
  | Op.Threads room «from» limit participated =>
    api_threads.get_threads_route s req.user room «from» limit participated
  | Op.State room => api_state.get_state_events_route s req.user room
  | Op.StateEvent room kind state_key =>
    api_state.get_state_events_for_key_route s req.user room kind state_key
  | Op.Members room «at» membership not_membership =>
    api_members.get_member_events_route s req.user room «at» membership
      not_membership
  | Op.JoinedMembers room => api_members.joined_members_route s req.user room
  | Op.InitialSync room limit =>

  | Op.RoomEvent room event =>

theorem toSigned_eq (l : U64) : Int.bmod (l.val : Int) (2 ^ 64) = toSigned l.val := by

theorem user_shared_history_ok (s : Snapshot) (hs room e u : U64)
    (h : svc_accessor.user_shared_history s hs room e u = ok true) :
    Joined s u.val room.val ∨ membershipAt s hs.val u.val = .Join ∨
      (OnceJoined s u.val room.val ∧ ∃ l c, leftCount s u.val room.val = some l ∧ countOf s e.val = some c ∧ c ≤ toSigned l) := by
  unfold svc_accessor.user_shared_history at h
  h5i_invert h
  · subst hc; left; unfold svc_cache.is_joined at hb; dsimp only at hb
    simpa [Joined, alloc.vec.Vec.deref] using has_row_ok _ _ _ hb
  · subst hc_1; right; left; exact user_was_joined_ok s hs u hb1
  · subst hc_2; right; right
    unfold svc_cache.once_joined at hb2; dsimp only at hb2
    have hj := has_row_ok _ _ _ hb2; simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.deref] at hj
    refine ⟨by simpa [OnceJoined] using hj, a.val, event_count.val, get_left_count_ok s room u a hr, get_pdu_count_ok s e _ hr1, ?_⟩
    simp [lift] at hi; subst hi
    simp at h
    have := toSigned_eq a
    have h3 : event_count.val ≤ (UScalar.hcast IScalarTy.I64 a).val := by scalar_tac
    rw [UScalar.hcast_val_eq] at h3
    have h5 : (2:Nat) ^ IScalarTy.I64.numBits = 2 ^ 64 := rfl
    rw [h5, this] at h3; exact h3

  rintro ⟨out, i⟩ r hinv hr
  simp only at hr hinv
  unfold api_message.event_ids_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · obtain ⟨c0, j⟩ := x
    change (do let p ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Pdu) s.pdus j; let out1 ← out.push p.event_id; let i3 ← i + 1#usize; ok (ControlFlow.cont (out1, i3))) = ok r at hr
    h5i_invert hr
    simp only
    have hi3v := add_ok_val hi3
    have hlt : i.val < evs.val.length := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨?_, by simp at hi3v; omega⟩
    have hmem := slice_index_ok_mem hx
    have hidx := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hp
    intro e he; rw [push_ok _ _ _ hout1] at he; simp at he
    rcases he with he | rfl
    · exact hinv e he
    · exact ⟨(c0, j), hmem, p, hidx, rfl⟩

def ChunkOk (s : Snapshot) (u room : U64) (chunk : alloc.vec.Vec U64) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ chunk.val, ∃ q, q ∈ s.pdus.val ∧ q.outlier = false ∧ q.room = room ∧ q.event_id = e ∧
    ¬ Ignored s u.val q ∧ Visible s u.val q.room.val q.event_id.val

theorem chunk_of (s : Snapshot) (u room : U64) (it : Slice Usize) (f : Filter) (x : U64)
    (evs : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize)) (evs' : Slice (I64 × Usize)) (chunk : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (hids : IdsInv s evs' chunk) (hscan : ScanInv s u it f x evs) (hevs : evs'.val = evs.val)
    (hgood : ∀ j ∈ it.val, Good s room j) : ChunkOk s u room chunk := by
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨ce, hce, q, hq, hqe⟩ := hids e he
  rw [hevs] at hce
  obtain ⟨hmem, hpass⟩ := hscan ce hce
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hign, hvis⟩ := passes_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ hpass
  obtain ⟨q', hq', hout, hroom⟩ := hgood _ hmem
  rw [hq] at hp hq'
  simp at hp hq'
  subst hp hq'
  exact ⟨q, List.mem_of_getElem? hq, hout, hroom, hqe, hign, hvis⟩

theorem resolve_base_ok (s : Snapshot) (u room ev : U64) (x : I64 × Usize)

theorem context_visible (s : Snapshot) (u room ev lim : U64) (f : Filter)
    (base : U64) (st en : I64) (before after state : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (h : transition s ⟨u, .Context room ev lim f⟩ = ok (.Ok (.Context base st en before after state)))
    (hk : Keys s) :
    base = ev ∧ ∀ e ∈ base :: (before.val ++ after.val), InRoom s room.val e.val ∧ Visible s u.val room.val e.val := by
  unfold transition api_context.get_context_route api_context.event_context at h
  h5i_invert h
  obtain ⟨base_count, base_pdu⟩ := x
  change (do let r1 ← svc_timeline.get_shortroomid s room; _) = _ at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨s3, state_at⟩ := x
    have hs3 : s3 = s := by
      h5i_invert hx
      all_goals try exact hx.1.symm
      all_goals
        obtain ⟨c, j⟩ := x
        simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at hx
        h5i_invert hx
        exact hx.1.symm
    subst s3
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at h
    h5i_invert h
  all_goals
    simp only [Reply.Context.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨hbase, -, -, hbefore, hafter, -⟩ := h
    subst before
    subst after
    subst base
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqe, hqt, hqr, hqv⟩ := resolve_base_ok s u room ev (base_count, base_pdu) hr
    have hpi := vec_index_slice_ok_get? hp
    rw [hpi] at hq
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hq
    subst q
    have hgood_before : ∀ j ∈ before_it.val, Good s room j := by
      revert hbefore_it
      cases r2 <;> simp
      · intro hh; subst before_it; exact pdus_rev_ok _ _ _ _ hr2
      · intro hh; subst before_it; simp
    have hgood_after : ∀ j ∈ after_it.val, Good s room j := by
      revert hafter_it
      cases r3 <;> simp
      · intro hh; subst after_it; exact pdus_ok _ _ _ _ hr3
      · intro hh; subst after_it; simp
    unfold api_context.collect_timeline_half at hevents_before hevents_after
    have hscan_before := collect_half_ok s u f a _ i _ _ _ hevents_before (by simp [ScanInv])
    have hscan_after := collect_half_ok s u f a _ i2 _ _ _ hevents_after (by simp [ScanInv])
    unfold api_message.event_ids at hv1 hv2
    have hids_before := event_ids_loop_ok s _ _ _ _ hv1 (by simp [IdsInv])
    have hids_after := event_ids_loop_ok s _ _ _ _ hv2 (by simp [IdsInv])
    have hchunk_before := chunk_of s u room _ f a events_before _ v1 hids_before hscan_before
      (by simp [alloc.vec.Vec.deref]) (by simpa [alloc.vec.Vec.deref] using hgood_before)
    have hchunk_after := chunk_of s u room _ f a events_after _ v2 hids_after hscan_after
      (by simp [alloc.vec.Vec.deref]) (by simpa [alloc.vec.Vec.deref] using hgood_after)
    refine ⟨hqe, ?_⟩
    intro e he
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_append] at he
    rcases he with rfl | he | he
    · exact ⟨⟨p, hqt, rfl, congrArg UScalar.val hqr⟩, by simpa [hqe] using hqv⟩
    all_goals
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hout, hroom, hid, hign, hvis⟩ := (by first | exact hchunk_before e he | exact hchunk_after e he)
      have hqt : q ∈ timeline s := by simp [timeline, hq, hout]
      exact ⟨⟨q, hqt, by rw [hid], by rw [hroom]⟩, by simpa [hroom, hid] using hvis⟩




theorem collect_matches_scan (s : Snapshot) (u short take : U64) (f : Filter)
    (it : Slice Usize) (dir : Dir) (out target : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize))
    (i : Usize) (scanned : Option I64) (res : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize) × Option I64)
    (hc : api_context.collect_timeline_half_loop s u f short false it take out i = ok target)
    (hs : api_message.scan_loop s u it none dir take f short false out scanned false i = ok res) :
    res.1 = target := by
  unfold api_message.scan_loop at hs
  refine loop_ok _
    (fun x => x.2.2.1 = false ∧ api_context.collect_timeline_half_loop s u f short false it take x.1 x.2.2.2 = ok target)
    (fun res => res.1 = target) (fun x => it.val.length - x.2.2.2.val)
    ?_ _ _ ⟨rfl, hc⟩ hs
  rintro ⟨out, scanned, done1, i⟩ r ⟨hd, hc⟩ hr
  simp only [Prod.fst, Prod.snd] at hd hc ⊢
  subst done1
  unfold api_context.collect_timeline_half_loop at hc
  rw [loop] at hc
  unfold api_context.collect_timeline_half_loop.body at hc
  unfold api_message.scan_loop.body api_message.reached_to at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · simp only [hc_1, if_pos, hi3, hc_2, hp, hp1, hb1, hevents1, hi4, bind_tc_ok] at hc
    simp only [bind_ok, hc_2, if_pos, hp, hp1, hb1, hevents1, hi4] at hc
    change api_context.collect_timeline_half_loop s u f short false it take events1 i4 = ok target at hc
    refine ⟨⟨rfl, hc⟩, ?_⟩
    have := add_ok_val hi4
    have := hc_1
    simp only [Slice.len] at this
    scalar_tac
  · simp only [hc_1, if_pos, hi3, hc_2, if_neg, bind_tc_ok, ok.injEq] at hc
    simpa only [bind_ok, hc_2, if_neg, if_false, ok.injEq] using hc
  · simp only [hc_1, if_neg, bind_tc_ok, ok.injEq] at hc
    simpa only [if_false, bind_ok, ok.injEq] using hc

theorem messages_ids_eq (s : Snapshot) (u room short take : U64) (c : I64) (dir : Dir)
    (f : Filter) (r : core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec Usize) Error) (it : alloc.vec.Vec Usize)
    (events : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize)) (ids chunk : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (st : I64) (en : Option I64)
    (hex : svc_timeline.exists s room = ok true)
    (hb : api_message.bounded (some take) api_message.LIMIT_DEFAULT api_message.LIMIT_MAX = ok take)
    (hit : (match r with | .Ok v => ok v | .Err _ => ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new Usize)) = ok it)
    (ht : (match dir with | .Forward => svc_timeline.pdus s room c | .Backward => svc_timeline.pdus_rev s room c) = ok r)
    (hshort : svc_timeline.get_shortroomid s room = ok (.Ok short))
    (hh : api_context.collect_timeline_half s u f short false it.deref take = ok events)
    (hi : api_message.event_ids s events.deref = ok ids)
    (h : transition s ⟨u, .Messages room (.At c) .Absent dir take f⟩ = ok (.Ok (.Messages st en chunk))) :
    chunk = ids := by
  unfold transition api_message.get_message_events_route api_message.get_messages at h
  cases dir
  all_goals simp only [hex, bind_ok, Bool.true_eq, if_true, if_false, hb, ht, hit, hshort] at h
  all_goals h5i_invert h
  all_goals casesm alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize) × Option I64
  all_goals simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at h
  all_goals h5i_invert h
  all_goals
    have htit : it1 = it := by
      cases r <;> simp_all only [ok.injEq]
    subst it1
    have he := half_matches_scan s u short take f it.deref _ events _ hh hx
    simp only [Prod.fst] at he
    rw [he, hi] at hv
    simp only [ok.injEq] at hv
    simp only [Reply.Messages.injEq] at h
    exact h.2.2.symm.trans hv.symm

theorem context_agrees_with_messages (s : Snapshot) (u room ev lim : U64) (f : Filter)
    (base : U64) (st en : I64) (before after state : alloc.vec.Vec U64) (c : I64)
    (k1 k2 : U64)
    (h : transition s ⟨u, .Context room ev lim f⟩ = ok (.Ok (.Context base st en before after state)))
    (hk : Keys s) (hc : countOf s ev.val = some c.val)
    (hk1 : k1.val = (min lim.val 100 + 1) / 2)
    (hk2 : k2.val = min lim.val 100 / 2)
    (st1 st2 : I64) (en1 en2 : Option I64) (c1 c2 : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (h1 : transition s ⟨u, .Messages room (.At c) .Absent .Forward k1 f⟩ = ok (.Ok (.Messages st1 en1 c1)))
    (h2 : transition s ⟨u, .Messages room (.At c) .Absent .Backward k2 f⟩ = ok (.Ok (.Messages st2 en2 c2))) :
    after = c1 ∧ before = c2 := by
  unfold transition api_context.get_context_route api_context.event_context at h
  h5i_invert h
  obtain ⟨base_count, base_pdu⟩ := x
  change (do let r1 ← svc_timeline.get_shortroomid s room; _) = _ at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨s3, state_at⟩ := x
    have hs3 : s3 = s := by
      h5i_invert hx
      all_goals try exact hx.1.symm
      all_goals
        obtain ⟨c, j⟩ := x
        simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at hx
        h5i_invert hx
        exact hx.1.symm
    subst s3
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at h
    h5i_invert h
  all_goals
    have hcount := resolve_count_eq s u room ev base_count base_pdu hr
    rw [hc] at hcount
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hcount
    have hbc : base_count = c := by scalar_tac
    subst base_count
    have hl := bounded_context_val lim limit1 hlimit1
    have hd := (div_ok_val hi).1
    have hm := (rem_ok_val hi1).1
    have ha := add_ok_val hi2
    have hkbefore : i = k2 := by scalar_tac
    have hkafter : i2 = k1 := by scalar_tac
    subst i
    subst i2
    have hk1bound : k1.val ≤ 50 := by omega
    have hk2bound : k2.val ≤ 50 := by omega
    have hexb : svc_timeline.exists s room = ok true := by simpa only [hc_1] using hb
    have haids := messages_ids_eq s u room a k1 c .Forward f r3 after_it events_after v2 c1 st1 en1
      hexb (bounded_messages_self k1 hk1bound) hafter_it hr3 hr1 hevents_after hv2 h1
    have hbids := messages_ids_eq s u room a k2 c .Backward f r2 before_it events_before v1 c2 st2 en2
      hexb (bounded_messages_self k2 hk2bound) hbefore_it hr2 hr1 hevents_before hv1 h2
    simp only [Reply.Context.injEq] at h
    exact ⟨h.2.2.2.2.1.symm.trans haids.symm, h.2.2.2.1.symm.trans hbids.symm⟩
